opening.argument: The video presents BitConnect as an earning opportunity built around depositing Bitcoin, buying or holding BCC, and lending through the platform. It states that holding the coin in an online wallet yields “120% per year!” and describes lending returns of “30 to 40 maximum percent per month.” The presentation reinforces that solicitation with a $1,000 projected-profit example over 299 days, a lending interface requiring payment from the BitConnect wallet, and links directing viewers to project discussions on Telegram. These are concrete instructions and return claims tied to participation, while the stated rates and returns remain unestablished.

citations.quote: If you keep the coin on your online wallet, then you start participating in the program 120% per year!
on average 30 to 40 maximum percent per month
